Entry.JapaneseText: きれいな所だな…… フルエーレの泉に似てる
Entry.EnglishText: Wow, this place is beautiful. It reminds me of the Fluere springs.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Kunzite>、先ほど 飛び降りた時に怪我を？
Entry.EnglishText: Kunzite, did you sustain any injuries when you leapt from such a height?

Entry.JapaneseText: 自己修復可能なレベルの損傷です。 問題ありません
Entry.EnglishText: I am capable of self-repairing this level of damage. There is no cause for concern.

Entry.JapaneseText: 問題あります！ 貴方には痛みや恐怖を感じる スピリアがあるんだもの
Entry.EnglishText: Yes, there certainly is cause for concern! You have a Spiria of which can feel pain and fear.

Entry.JapaneseText: 否……やはり自分は アナタのあたたかさのためならば どんな痛みも問題ないと感じます
Entry.EnglishText: Negative. If it is for the sake of you and your warmth, there is no pain that I am unwilling to bear.

Entry.JapaneseText: あら、<Kunzite> まるで告白のようですわよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Goodness, Kunzite. That almost sounded a bit like a profession.

Entry.JapaneseText: 告白……？ 肯定。自分は自分の認識を アナタに告白しました
Entry.EnglishText: Profession... Affirmative. I professed my perception of you.

Entry.JapaneseText: うふふ……貴方のスピリアも まだまだ成長が足りませんわね
Entry.EnglishText: Hehe. I see your Spiria still has room to grow.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……そう、これが わたくしの世界でした。 争いと退廃に満ちていたけれど
Entry.EnglishText: ...Yes, this was the world in which I lived. Though full of strife and corruption―

Entry.JapaneseText: 優しいフローラ姉様…… 明るさを忘れない街の人々…… 頼もしい<Kunzite>……
Entry.EnglishText: Fluora's kindness... the people of the city who never lost hope... and my ever reliable Kunzite...

Entry.JapaneseText: そして、理想に燃えるクリード—— みんなの想いが生きていた 懐かしい懐かしい世界……
Entry.EnglishText: And even Creed with his passionate ideals―it was a world alive with emotion that I miss dearly...

Entry.JapaneseText: やはりここにいたか、リチア！
Entry.EnglishText: There you are, Lithia!

Entry.JapaneseText: クリード！ よくここがわかりましたね？
Entry.EnglishText: Creed! You decided to visit too?

Entry.JapaneseText: 当然だ。 この泉は私とフローラとお前…… 三人の約束の地ではないか
Entry.EnglishText: Of course. To you, Fluora and myself... this spring is our promised land.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここで、幾度理想世界について 語り合ったか……新世界への 出発にふさわしい場所だ
Entry.EnglishText: How many times have we spoke of our ideal world here... this is a place worthy of departue to a new world.

Entry.JapaneseText: かつてフルエーレという スピリアを映す精霊が 棲息したという泉——
Entry.EnglishText: It's said this fountain was once home to spirits that react to Spiria known as Fluere―

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、今はフルエーレも フローラ姉様もいません……
Entry.EnglishText: But now, neither the Fluere or Fluora are with us...

Entry.JapaneseText: フローラにはフルエーレなどより ずっと素晴らしい世界をプレゼント してやろう……私とリチアでな
Entry.EnglishText: We'll give Fluora a world even more beautiful than the Fluere. The two of us, together.

Entry.JapaneseText: わたくしとあなたで—— その言葉が嬉しかった…… けれど……
Entry.EnglishText: Together? I am grateful for your words, however...

Entry.JapaneseText: 共に行こう。 新世界を生み出す黒き月—— 『ガルデニア』へ
Entry.EnglishText: Let's go. To the Ebony Moon that shall give birth to a new world―Gardenia.
...I will!

Entry.JapaneseText: 行ってはいけません！ ガルデニアで理想の 世界なんてつくれないッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: You musn't! It's impossible to create an ideal world using Gardenia!

Entry.JapaneseText: みんな『白化』してしまうッ！ 残るのは果てしない 恐怖と後悔だけなのですッ!
Entry.EnglishText: Everyone will calcify! All that remains is an endless despair and regret!

Entry.JapaneseText: だめッ……だめです……ッッ！ お願い、お願い、お願い…………ッ
Entry.EnglishText: No... you can't...! Please, I'm begging you...

Entry.JapaneseText: 誰かわたくしを とめてぇぇぇーーーッッ！！！
Entry.EnglishText: Somebody stop me!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: ガルデニアが……発動したッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Gardenia just... activated.

Entry.JapaneseText: フローラの救出なんて認めないぞ！ 僕は奴隷の身に戻る気はないんだ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I won't allow you to tecue Fluora! I have no intention of returning to a life of slavery!!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ならば、オマエは なぜクリードに手を貸していた？ なぜガルデニアに行こうとする？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Then why are you aiding Creed? Why did you return to Gardenia?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ふん、隙をついて クリードを倒すためさ！
Entry.EnglishText: ...Hmph, so I can defeat Creed while his back is turned!

Entry.JapaneseText: そうさ！ 結晶人も、原界人も 皆殺しにして、機械人だけの 永遠の世界をつくるんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: I'm going to wipe out the Quartz AND the Cellites and bring about an eternal world for only us mechanoids!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……好きにしろ。 俺はクリードとリチアを殺し フローラ様を救い出すだけだ
Entry.EnglishText: ...Do whatever you want. All I want is to kill Creed and Lithia in order to rescue Master Fluora.

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、フローラ様に 危害を加えるのならば ロア、オマエも破壊する
Entry.EnglishText: However if you intend to bring harm to Master Fluora, I will destroy even you, Lor.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……それはこっちのセリフさ。 フローラを復活させる気なら 今ここで、バラバラにしてやる
Entry.EnglishText: ...Took the words right out of my mouth. If you really mean to rescue Fluora, I might as well tear you to shreds right here and now!

Entry.JapaneseText: 捕捉したぞ、セラフたち！ リチア様は返してもらう!!
Entry.EnglishText: We have you surrounded! Release Master Lithia at once!

Entry.JapaneseText: ふん、リチアを取り返す 意味があるのか？ リノ、聞かせてやれ
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph, is there even any point in releasing her now? Lino, play it for them.

Entry.JapaneseText: 許して……ください……この罪は わたくしの命で償います…… だから……どうか許して……
Entry.EnglishText: Please forgive me... I will atone for my sins with my life... so please... just forgive me...

Entry.JapaneseText: ３８８回目の 『白化の日』再生以来 この言葉しか口にしなくなった
Entry.EnglishText: Since the 388th replay of the day of calcification, she has only ever muttered these words.
Master Lithia...

Entry.JapaneseText: リチアは、自分を生けにえにして ガルデニアをとめる気なんだろ？
Entry.EnglishText: She really intends on sacrificing herself to stop Gardenia, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: あはは、<Kunzite>！ キミの目的もリチアを 殺す事じゃないか!!
Entry.EnglishText: Haha, then aren't our goals the same Kunzite? To kill Lithia!

Entry.JapaneseText: リチアの殺害を許容するのならば オマエたちと手を組んでもいい。 クリードを殺すため力を貸せ
Entry.EnglishText: If you will allow me the honors of Lithia's murder, then I am willing to join forces with you. Help me kill Creed too!
Tch... I...

Entry.JapaneseText: 悩む事はないだろ？ 大切な主が死を 望んでいるんだからさ！
Entry.EnglishText: What's there to be upset about? Even your Master herself wishes to die!

Entry.JapaneseText: 違う！ <Kunzite>はリチアを 叱り飛ばしに来たんだ!!
Entry.EnglishText: You're wrong! Kunzite came here to give Lithia a talking to!

Entry.JapaneseText: そうだよ！ 『死ぬなんて 絶対に不許可だ』ってね!!
Entry.EnglishText: Exactly! He's going to tell her that he will NEVER allow her to die!

Entry.JapaneseText: この人、こ〜見えて 超〜〜〜熱血なんだよっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: You'd never guess, but this guy can be SUUUPER hot-headed when he wants to!

Entry.JapaneseText: 二千年も生きてるクセに ちょっと少年すぎるほどに、ね♪
Entry.EnglishText: He may have lived for over 2,000 years, but he still acts like a young boy in his own ways. ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: いいかげんにしろ、<Kunzite>！ てめぇは、リチアの死を 認める気か？
Entry.EnglishText: Pull it together, Kunzite! Are you really just gonna sit back and let her die?

Entry.JapaneseText: 理屈も世界も使命も関係ねぇ！ てめぇのスピリアは リチアをどうしたいんだッ！！？
Entry.EnglishText: Forget the reason, the world, your mission, everything! What does your Spiria wish for her?!

Entry.JapaneseText: 自分は…… 自分は……リチア様に…………
Entry.EnglishText: I... I want... Master Lithia...
To live on!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: どんなに辛くとも、自ら死を 望まれていても、生きて欲しいッ！ 生けにえなど、絶対に不許可だ!!
Entry.EnglishText: No matter how painful things may be, and even if she herself wishes for death, I want her to live on! Self-sacrifice is strictly forbidden!

Entry.JapaneseText: へっ……ムカつくが俺も同じだぜ。 リチアを犠牲にはしねぇッ！ そうだろ、<Shing>!!
Entry.EnglishText: Heh. I hate to say it, but we agree on this one. I'll never let her sacrifice herself! Ain't that right, Shing?

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ！ オレたちみんなで リチアのスピリアをッ！ リチアの命をッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah! We're taking back her Spiria AND her life!
I shall protect her!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: なぜだ、<Kunzite>…… なぜキミは、人のために 恐怖を超えられるんだッ！！？
Entry.EnglishText: How do you do it, Kunzite... how can you overcome your fears for the sake of another?!

Entry.JapaneseText: なぜ？ なぜ？ なぜだッ？ 僕と同じ偽物のスピリアのくせに ……むかつくんだよォォッ！！！
Entry.EnglishText: Why? Why? WHY?! Even though we have the same synthetic Spiria... it pisses me off!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: リノ！ オマエとの決着は コイツらを始末した後だ！
Entry.EnglishText: Lino! We'll settle things AFTER we get rid of these pests!

Entry.JapaneseText: リンクドライブ・モードで 一気にかたをつける！ 統合管制システム起動!!
Entry.EnglishText: Engaging Link Drive mode! Activating coordinated control system!

Entry.JapaneseText: 了解。 全戦闘機能セーフティー解除。 統合管制システム接続
Entry.EnglishText: Understood. All combat safety precautions cancelled. Connecting coordinated control system.

Entry.JapaneseText: こ、こいつらも リンクしたぁっ!?
Entry.EnglishText: A-Are they gonna link?!

Entry.JapaneseText: 警告！ セラフたち本来の戦闘形態 リンクドライブ・モードだ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Caution! The Seraph's are activating their unique battle formation Link Drive mode!

Entry.JapaneseText: 感覚と戦闘思考を共有した 二身一体の連携攻撃がくるぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: Incoming assault from their senses and combat skills combines as one across both bodies!

Entry.JapaneseText: リンクドライブ・モード。 せん滅戦闘を開始する
Entry.EnglishText: Link Drive mode active. Commencing annihilation.

Entry.JapaneseText: こんなの本当のリンクじゃないさ！
Entry.EnglishText: That's not what a real Link is!

Entry.JapaneseText: 本当に守るべき人もわからない あなたたちなんかに 負けるもんかッ！
Entry.EnglishText: Someone who can't even understand the desire to protect someone else won't stand a chance against us!

Entry.JapaneseText: アクセスパスは返してもらったぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: The access pass is safe and sound!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここまでだ、セラフたち。 リチア様のスピリアを解放せよ
Entry.EnglishText: It is over, Seraphs. Release Master Lithia's Spiria at once.

Entry.JapaneseText: うそだ……僕たちの リンクドライブが敗れるなんて…… もう一度リンクだ、リノッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: No... There's no way our Link Drive could lose... Link up again, Lino!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……無駄だ。 俺とロアでは コイツらには勝てない……
Entry.EnglishText: That would only prove futile. We are not enough to defeat them...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……だがッ！ 今、この瞬間にも フローラ様は、ガルデニアの 中で苦しんでおられるのだ！
Entry.EnglishText: ...However! Master Fluora is suffering within Gardenia as we speak!

Entry.JapaneseText: 俺はあきらめない！ どんな 手段を使っても、必ず主の…… あたたかな笑顔を取り戻すッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I will not give up! By any means necessary... I will reclaim my Master's kind smile!!
Ah... ahhh...!

Entry.JapaneseText: てめぇ、まだこんな力をッ!?
Entry.EnglishText: You still got THAT much fight in ya?!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……まずい！ 全員、ふせろーーーッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: ...This is bad! Everyone, hide!

Entry.JapaneseText: くっ、目標消失！ 周囲にセラフたちの反応なし
Entry.EnglishText: Tch, target lost. There is no sign of the Seraphs in the surrounding area.

Entry.JapaneseText: ど、どうすんのさ<Shing>!? あいつらの行き先が わかんないよぉ？
Entry.EnglishText: Wh-What do we do, Shing?! We have no idea where they could be!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ジャックシードへ向かおう。 クリノセラフはフローラさんの 救出をあきらめてなかった
Entry.EnglishText: ...Let's head to Jackseed. Clinoseraph is still trying to rescue Fluora.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Shing>に同意する。 ヤツはアクセスパスを狙って 必ず再び姿を現すはずだ
Entry.EnglishText: Agreed. He is after the access pass. Our paths are bound to cross again.

Entry.JapaneseText: きれいな泉だ。ここは本当に リチアの大切な場所なんだね
Entry.EnglishText: What a beautiful spring. This place must mean a lot to you, Lithia.

Entry.JapaneseText: な、何を考えているのです！ 塔から落ちたわたくしに スピルリンクするなんて!!
Entry.EnglishText: W-what are you thinking?! Why would your Spirlink with me as I fall?!

Entry.JapaneseText: う〜ん、特に考えてないなぁ？ リチアをひとりぼっちにしちゃ いけないって思っただけなんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Hmm, I kinda just did it without thinking? I just knew I couldn't leave you all on your own.

Entry.JapaneseText: バカ！ バカ!! こんなの無駄死にですわ！ 全ては終わりです!!
Entry.EnglishText: How could you be so stupid?! You're going to die in vain! It's all over!!

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ……二千年も生きて 結局わたくしは何ひとつ 守れなかった……
Entry.EnglishText: *Sigh...* I've lived for over two thousand years, yet in the end I couldn't save anyone...

Entry.JapaneseText: 終わりじゃないよ。 ほら、みんなとの リンクはつながってる！
Entry.EnglishText: It's not over yet. Look, we're Linked with everyone else!

Entry.JapaneseText: 地上に叩き付けられる時に ソーマリンクなんか…… なんの力にもなりませんわ！
Entry.EnglishText: But the force of impact from falling from such a height... not even the power of a Soma Link could save us!

Entry.JapaneseText: うん……リンクはスピリアを 触れ合わせるだけの小さな力だ。 けど、あきらめさえしなければ……
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah... Links are tiny things that can only reach your Spiria. But, if you refuse to give up...

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界を超えて無限に つながっていく力なんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: It can be a force that transcends the world, connecting everything as one!

Entry.JapaneseText: ほら、みんなオレと リチアを信じてくれてる！ 生きる勇気を伝えてくれてるよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: See? Everyone here believes in us! They're giving us the courage to keep living!!

Entry.JapaneseText: この輝きがある限り どんな絶望からも立ち上がれるさ！
Entry.EnglishText: A long as you have this brilliant light... you can climb your way out of the depths of despair!

Entry.JapaneseText: あきらめない希望の光 ……寿命の残っていない わたくしには残酷な光です……
Entry.EnglishText: The light of hope to never give up... How cruel to shine it upon me, who has no life left to live...

Entry.JapaneseText: わかってる…… それでも、受け取って欲しいんだ
Entry.EnglishText: I know... even so, I want to to take it.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……罪人のわたくしが受け取って 良い想いなのでしょうか？ それにガルデニアを倒すには……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Can a sinner like me truly accept such pure feelings? And to defeat Gardenia...
Of course.

Entry.JapaneseText: この光こそ、リチアが守ってきた 世界の輝きなんだから!!
Entry.EnglishText: This light is the radiant world you've fought to protect!!

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ………… わがままだとわかっています。 自分の罪も忘れはしません
Entry.EnglishText: Ahh... I know it is selfish of me, and I will never forget my sins--

Entry.JapaneseText: でも……でも、わたくしは このあたたかな光に満ちた世界を
Entry.EnglishText: But... but I wish to see the world filled with such a warm light--
--I want to keep living!!

Entry.JapaneseText: 生きよう、この光と一緒に!!
Entry.EnglishText: Then let's live in this shining light!!

Entry.JapaneseText: 全員のソーマリンクが強くなった
Entry.EnglishText: Everyone's Soma Link went up.

Entry.EnglishText: %s and friend's Soma Link went up.
